title: AssetTotsDaiLeverageExecutor.getAsset() should use `redeem(collateralAmountIn)` instead of `redeem(convertToShares(colla
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, users will get lesser DAI when converting their sDAI.  **Likelihood:** High, will happen every time `getAsset()` is called.  ## Description  sDai is an ERC4626 contract. Dai is the native asset and sDai is the share. When withdrawing assets, if `withdraw()` is called, the function takes in the asset value and returns the amount of the underlying asset. When `redeem()` is called, the function takes in the share value and returns the amount of the underlying asset. Usually, the shares are worth more than the asset, eg 1 sDai : 1.05 Dai.
